notes: Read all 135 numbered source lines before editing. Native port follows the established dashboard idiom (ChargingOptimizerWidget / BatteryHealthAnalyticsWidget / DriveEfficiencyChartWidget / EnergyFlowWidget): every not-yet-ported web dependency (WidgetShell, DataFreshness, AnimatedNumber, MetricCard, EmptyState icon, lucide-react, useUnits, unitConversion, numberFormat, react-i18next, types) is reproduced inline native-safe with RN primitives + the shared native AppText/EmptyState/tokens and documented here. No DOM, react-router, framer-motion, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported.

L1 `import { useMemo }` -> native `import {useMemo}` (plus useEffect/useState for the inline freshness 30s tick). L2 react-i18next useTranslation('dashboard') -> module-level English-default `t(key, fallback, vars?)` with {{var}} interpolation, keeping every widget.odometer.* / freshness.* key verbatim; used in the component, CompactView, ExpandedView and the freshness chip exactly where web called `t`.

L3 lucide-react Gauge/Calendar/TrendingUp -> no native icon font: Gauge -> GaugeGlyph '\u25F4' tinted neon cyan (colors.accent) for the non-compact shell header AND dropped from the EmptyState (native EmptyState has no icon slot — the gauge signal is preserved by the header glyph); TrendingUp -> '\u2197' emerald-300 (#6ee7b7) in the Total Driven metric card; Calendar -> '\u25A6' amber-300 (#fcd34d) in the Unit metric card.

L4 @/components/data-display AnimatedNumber -> inline `AnimatedNumber`: the web ease-out-quad count-up (display 0 -> value over 1s via requestAnimationFrame) renders its final rest-state value immediately (fmtNumber(value, decimals) + prefix/suffix), following the EnergyFlowWidget idiom in this directory so the value is visually identical at rest AND synchronously assertable; tabular-nums + bold + cyan styling preserved (fontVariant ['tabular-nums'], fontWeight '700', #67e8f9). MetricCard -> inline compact `MetricCard` (label + bold value + colour-tinted icon box) mirroring the web small card; web neonColorMap green/amber tints reproduced (green icon #6ee7b7 on rgba(16,185,129,0.1) box, amber icon #fcd34d on rgba(245,158,11,0.1) box).

L5 @/components/feedback EmptyState -> shared native EmptyState (../../../../components/feedback/EmptyState): web's single `message` becomes the native `title` (message=''); the web Gauge `icon` + `className='py-4'` have no native EmptyState slot and are dropped, documented above.

L6 useVehicles + useVehicleState imported unchanged from ../../../api/hooks/useVehicles (same /vehicles and /vehicles/{id}/state paths). L7 useDrivingStats imported unchanged from ../../../api/hooks/useDriving (same /drives/stats?vehicle_id=… path). L8 @/hooks/useUnits -> inline `useUnits()` deriving unitPrefs.distance from the native useSettings exactly as web deriveDistance (unit_of_length === 'mi' -> 'mi' else 'km'); only distance is read so the mirror exposes just that pref (useMemo for reference stability).

L9 @/lib/numberFormat fmtNumber -> inlined verbatim (safeNumber guard, en-US grouping; the not-yet-wired global precision default 2 is irrelevant because every call passes an explicit 0). L10 './WidgetShell' -> inline `WidgetShell`: loading -> skeleton (testID odometer-counter-loading); error -> centred errorBox + retry Pressable mirroring web <QueryError> (this widget never passes an error, so it is inert but preserved); titled -> header (GaugeGlyph + uppercase muted title + WidgetFreshness) over body; title-less (compact) -> body with WidgetFreshness overlaid top-right (web absolute top-1.5 right-1.5). Honours exactly the props this widget passes (title, icon, loading, updatedAt, isFetching, isStale, isError, onRefresh).

L11 './types' WidgetProps -> local `WidgetProps`/`WidgetSize` (vehicleId + size.cols/size.rows read). L12 @/lib/unitConversion convertDistanceFromSI -> inlined verbatim (km=m/1000, mi=m/1609.344, ft=m/0.3048; NIST constants).

L14-18 default export OdometerCounterWidget({vehicleId, size}); useTranslation -> inline t; const {data: vehicles} = useVehicles(); id = vehicleId ?? vehicles?.[0]?.id ?? 0; idStr = id > 0 ? String(id) : undefined — preserved verbatim.

L20 useVehicleState(id) destructured as data:stateData/isLoading:stateLoading/isFetching/isStale/isError/dataUpdatedAt/refetch — names preserved verbatim. L21 useDrivingStats(idStr) destructured as data:stats/isLoading:statsLoading. L22 const {unitPrefs} = useUnits(). L23 toDistanceDisplay = (value) => convertDistanceFromSI(value, unitPrefs.distance) — native wraps this in useCallback over [unitPrefs.distance] (the react-hooks/exhaustive-deps-recommended fix); the converted output is identical to the web per-render closure, only reference stability differs. L25 distanceUnit = unitPrefs.distance — all preserved.

L27 isCompact = size.cols === 1 && size.rows === 1; L28 isWide = size.cols >= 2 — preserved verbatim. L30 odometer = stateData?.state?.odometer ?? null: the native hook types state as VehicleState|string|null, so rawState is narrowed (`rawState != null && typeof rawState === 'object'`) before the odometer read; the API on this path only yields a VehicleState object or undefined, so behaviour matches the web `any`-typed access. L31 totalDistanceKm = stats?.totalDistanceKm ?? null (the web treats this field as SI metres and feeds it to convertDistanceFromSI; that exact behaviour is preserved, faithful regardless of the field's km-suffixed name).

L33-36 convertedOdometer useMemo(() => odometer != null ? toDistanceDisplay(odometer) : null, [odometer, toDistanceDisplay]) ported verbatim (toDistanceDisplay is a stable useCallback, so the dep list is honest). L37-40 convertedTotalDriven useMemo(() => totalDistanceKm != null ? toDistanceDisplay(totalDistanceKm) : null, [totalDistanceKm, toDistanceDisplay]) ported verbatim. L42 isLoading = stateLoading || statsLoading.

L44-54 return <WidgetShell title={isCompact ? undefined : t('widget.odometer.title','Odometer')} icon={isCompact ? undefined : <GaugeGlyph/>} loading={isLoading} updatedAt={dataUpdatedAt} isFetching isStale isError onRefresh={() => refetch()}> — every prop preserved verbatim (web L47 lucide Gauge text-neon-cyan -> GaugeGlyph colors.accent).

L55-68 body: convertedOdometer != null ? (isCompact ? <CompactView odometer unit/> : <ExpandedView odometer totalDriven={convertedTotalDriven} unit isWide/>) — preserved verbatim. L69-75 else branch: web <EmptyState icon=<Gauge/> message=… className='py-4'> -> native <EmptyState title={t('widget.odometer.noData','No odometer data')} message=''> inside the shell (section never hidden; web no-action comment honoured — transient empty state, no recovery action). L76-78 shell/component close.

L80-89 CompactView({odometer, unit}) -> native: a centred column (items-center justify-center gap-1) with <AnimatedNumber value={odometer} decimals={0}/> in text-2xl(24)/bold/cyan-300(#67e8f9)/tabular-nums and a 10px muted uppercase tracking-wider unit label — preserved (testIDs odometer-counter-compact / odometer-counter-value).

L91-114 ExpandedView({odometer, totalDriven, unit, isWide}): inline t (web re-called useTranslation('dashboard')); a justify-center column (gap-3) with a centred block: 10px muted uppercase 'Total Odometer' caption (mb-1) over <AnimatedNumber value={odometer} decimals={0} suffix={` ${unit}`}/> in text-3xl(30)/bold/cyan-300/tabular-nums — preserved (testID odometer-counter-expanded).

L116-132 isWide breakdown: a 2-col grid (gap-2) of two compact MetricCards — Total Driven (value = totalDriven != null ? `${fmtNumber(totalDriven,0)} ${unit}` : '\u2014', TrendingUp glyph, color green) and Unit (value = unit, Calendar glyph, color amber) — preserved verbatim (testIDs odometer-counter-metric-total-driven / odometer-counter-metric-unit). L133-135 close.

L1-12 DataFreshness (the web WidgetShell's freshness chip, transitively used by L10) reproduced inline as `WidgetFreshness`: same isError>fetching>stale>fresh precedence, dot colour tiers (emerald-400/sky-400/amber-400/red-400), 'just now / Nm/Nh/Nd/Nw ago' relative ladder, 'updating…'/'error' labels, a 30s re-render tick, and onRefresh wired to a Pressable (testIDs odometer-counter-freshness / -dot).

Companion __tests__/OdometerCounterWidgetParity.test.tsx mocks useVehicles/useVehicleState (useVehicles module), useDrivingStats (useDriving module) and useSettings, and renders: state-loading skeleton; stats-loading skeleton; title-less compact view (50,000 m -> 50 km, freshness overlay, no 'Odometer' header, no expanded view); expanded non-wide (1x2) view (Odometer header + 'Total Odometer' caption + '200 km', no metric cards); wide (2x2) view (both metric cards, '200 km', Total Driven '150 km', Unit chip); em-dash Total Driven when stats are absent; mi conversion (160,934.4 m -> '100 mi', no 'km'); empty state inside the shell when odometer is null (section never hidden); vehicleId fallback to first vehicle id (useVehicleState(7), useDrivingStats('7')); explicit vehicleId (42 / '42'); and the disabled-stats path (id 0 -> useVehicleState(0), useDrivingStats(undefined)). Every test unmounts so the 30s freshness interval leaves no open handle.
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint .), npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest).
